style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, warm analog film grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling. No text, no captions, no inscriptions, no readable letters, no film stock branding, no Kodak or Portra labels, no frame numbers, no aspect ratio markers, no watermarks. No modern objects, no asphalt, no painted road markings, no vehicles, no cars, no motorcycles, no machinery. No human figures, no faces, no body parts, no hands. 1st-century Mediterranean Levantine setting only.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: The Centurion's Faith
images.concept: Faith greater than all Israel — found in the last person anyone expected
images.imageAlt: A heavy stone threshold with light coming through a gap beneath a closed door, the gap barely wide enough for the light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close-up of a heavy ancient stone threshold at the base of a closed wooden door, a thin line of bright warm light bleeding under the door into the dark interior stone floor, the gap between door and stone barely a centimeter yet the light insists, heavy warm analog film grain in the dark floor stone, muted palette of dark gray stone and warm amber light sliver, the closed door and its insisting light is the entire subject — distance cannot stop what is authorized, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: Widow of Nain's Son Raised
images.concept: Compassion met at the city gate — death reversed for a mother who had lost everything
images.imageAlt: A narrow stone gate opening in a thick wall, the passage between dark interior and bright exterior, dry herbs laid across the threshold
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a narrow stone gate passage in an ancient thick wall seen from slightly inside, the interior in cool shadow while the exterior beyond blazes with warm light, a few dried herbs or small branches laid across the stone threshold, the contrast between cool dark and warm light creating a threshold of transformation, heavy film grain in the shadow interior, muted palette of cool gray stone inside and warm bleached light outside, the threshold as the place where death and life meet, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: John's Question from Prison
images.concept: Are you the one? — the doubt of the forerunner answered with evidence, not argument
images.imageAlt: A small barred window high in a stone wall, a slant of light crossing through it into a dark stone interior
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a small square window high in a thick stone wall, two rough iron bars crossing the opening, a diagonal shaft of light entering through the bars and cutting across the dark stone interior below, the light sharp and geometrically defined, the bars casting doubled shadows in the shaft, heavy warm analog film grain in the deep shadow stone, muted palette of dark cool gray and warm amber light shaft, the bounded light inside darkness — hope reaching through confinement, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: Jesus' Testimony about John
images.concept: More than a prophet — the voice at the hinge of history, standing at the border of two ages
images.imageAlt: Desert grass at the edge of a stone path, bent dramatically by wind, the path continuing into haze
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, wild dry desert grass at the edge of a stone path, the grass bent dramatically in one direction as if by strong wind, the path visible at the frame edge and continuing into pale haze ahead, the grass movement frozen in the photograph creating tension between stillness and motion, heavy warm analog film grain, muted warm palette of dry grass gold and pale stone, the bending grass as the herald who bends toward what is coming, Kinfolk magazine aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: The Woman Who Loved Much
images.concept: Tears on feet, perfume poured out — extravagant love as the only response to radical forgiveness
images.imageAlt: A small perfume vessel tipped on its side on a stone floor, a dark spreading pool of oil around it, catching lamplight
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a small ancient alabaster or unglazed ceramic vessel tipped on its side on a worn stone floor, a dark liquid pool spreading slowly around it and catching the warm glow of a nearby lamp just out of frame, the pooled liquid reflecting a single point of warm amber light, the vessel's mouth open and emptied, heavy film grain throughout, muted palette of pale stone and dark reflective liquid, the poured-out vessel is the entire subject — extravagance without calculation, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9
